Cronfield. Warring- ton has long been a stronghold for •thleties of every dlacription, and occupying a prominent position among them is the pastime of bowling. The cleverest exponents of the art of trundling an town are now acknowledged to be the Cemetery Hotel Bowling Club, though they have rivals which run them close for the honour.
